name: Glassmorphism
description: Frosted glass effect with transparency and blur
implementation: backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: rgba(255 255 255 / 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255 255 255 / 0.2);
use_cases: SaaS dashboards fintech cards premium overlays
do_examples: Use on cards over gradient backgrounds with subtle borders
dont_examples: Don't stack multiple glass layers or use on busy image backgrounds

name: Neomorphism
description: Soft extruded plastic look with inner/outer shadows
do_examples: Use on light backgrounds with subtle depth for interactive elements
dont_examples: Don't use for text-heavy layouts or on dark backgrounds where shadows disappear

name: Brutalism
description: Raw intentionally rough design with bold typography
implementation: font-weight: 900; border: 3px solid black; text-transform: uppercase; mix-blend-mode: difference;
do_examples: Use bold borders clashing colors and raw typography intentionally
dont_examples: Don't use for corporate healthcare or financial products

name: Minimalism
description: Maximum whitespace limited palette clean typography
use_cases: Luxury brands portfolios premium SaaS editorial
do_examples: Use generous whitespace high-quality imagery and one accent color
dont_examples: Don't make it boring — minimalism needs one strong visual anchor

name: Dark Mode
description: Dark backgrounds with carefully chosen contrast
use_cases: Developer tools fintech gaming dashboards AI products
do_examples: Use 3-4 shades of dark for depth with high-contrast accent colors
dont_examples: Don't use pure black (#000) or low-contrast text on dark backgrounds

name: Gradient Mesh
use_cases: AI products creative tools landing pages hero sections
do_examples: Use as hero backgrounds or accent elements with blur overlay
dont_examples: Don't use as background for text-heavy content sections

name: Bento Grid
description: Asymmetric grid cards like Japanese bento boxes
implementation: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4 1fr); gap: 16px; grid-auto-rows: minmax(200px auto);
use_cases: Feature showcases SaaS dashboards portfolio layouts
do_examples: Use varied card sizes with clear visual hierarchy and hover states
dont_examples: Don't make all cards the same size or pack too much info per card

name: Retro/Vintage
description: Nostalgic design with muted colors and classic typography
implementation: font-family: 'DM Serif Display'; color: #92400E; border-radius: 0; text-transform: uppercase;
use_cases: Craft brands coffee shops artisan products
do_examples: Use warm muted tones textured backgrounds and serif typography
dont_examples: Don't mix with modern UI patterns or glassmorphism

name: Cyberpunk
description: High-tech neon on dark with glitch effects
implementation: background: #0A0A0F; color: #00FF41; text-shadow: 0 0 10px #00FF41; animation: glitch 2s infinite;
do_examples: Use neon accents on dark backgrounds with glitch/scan effects
dont_examples: Don't use for serious professional or healthcare applications

name: Organic/Biomorphic
description: Natural flowing shapes inspired by nature
do_examples: Use blob shapes soft curves and nature-inspired color palettes
dont_examples: Don't use sharp corners or cold industrial colors

name: Claymorphism
description: 3D clay-like elements with soft shadows and rounded shapes
implementation: background: #F0F0F0; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 8px 8px 16px rgba(0 0 0 0.1) inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255 255 255 0.7);
use_cases: Kids apps friendly products playful interfaces
do_examples: Use soft rounded shapes pastel colors and playful shadows
dont_examples: Don't use for serious B2B or financial applications

name: Flat Design 2.0
description: Flat design with subtle shadows and depth cues
use_cases: E-commerce SaaS productivity tools general purpose
do_examples: Use flat colors with subtle elevation changes on hover/active states
dont_examples: Don't make it completely flat without any depth or feedback cues

name: Swiss/International
description: Grid-based layout with strong typography and minimal decoration
implementation: display: grid; gap: 32px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.2;
use_cases: Architecture firms design agencies museum sites
do_examples: Use strict grid alignment bold typography and asymmetric layouts
dont_examples: Don't add decorative elements that break the grid system

name: Aurora/Northern Lights
description: Animated gradient backgrounds mimicking aurora borealis
implementation: background: conic-gradient(from 180deg at 50% 50% #6366F1 #EC4899 #8B5CF6 #6366F1); filter: blur(80px); animation: rotate 20s linear infinite;
use_cases: AI products creative platforms landing page heroes
do_examples: Use as ambient background with blur and gentle animation
dont_examples: Don't overdo animation speed or use on content-heavy pages

name: Material Design 3
description: Google's design system with dynamic color and motion
implementation: border-radius: 16px; elevation: var(--md-sys-elevation-1); transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2 0 0 1);
use_cases: Android apps Google ecosystem cross-platform products
do_examples: Follow Material 3 token system with dynamic color theming
dont_examples: Don't mix Material with other design systems or custom elevation scales
